jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to take our Engineering and Training Simulators to the next level, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a passionate:

Software Developer Simulation (d/f/m)

We develop top notch, high fidelity simulations for a variety of aircraft, supporting the entire development life cycle. We have the technical responsibility for all our simulators. We design, develop, integrate and deliver complex training & engineering simulations to our customers. At the core, our simulations are distributed real-time applications. Most of our software is written in C++, but you might also find yourself writing & adopting Python or Ada occasionally.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Design the architecture of software models and components for new simulator functionality
- Develop simulation models (C++) representing aircraft equipment and sub-/systems
- Create and perform unit tests of simulation models and modules (C++ / Python)
- Create tools for improving our development processes (e.g. code generators)
- Perform integration and acceptance testing

Desired skills and qualifications

- Degree in Computer Science or similar
- At least 3 to 5 years of professional experience required
- Extensive experience in Software architecture, design and development
- Excellent C++ skills, Other programming languages / Frameworks are welcome (Qt / QML, Ada, Python...)
- English negotiation level

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Procurement Commodity Manager (f/m/d), you participate in project meetings and define procurement and supplier strategies to achieve the best possible award result in terms of cost, quality, and other project objectives. You will foster close communication with various interface departments and coordinate comprehensive internal communications, which includes summarizing the award process for internal approvals.

In addition, you will engage with suppliers relevant to your material fields and actively monitor the market to identify suitable suppliers for each project. Staying informed and continuously developing your expertise through exchanges with procurement colleagues and Real Estate partners will be essential to your success in this role.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Manage the procurement of national and international construction services, technical building equipment, and engineering services based on Real Estate requirements
* Create (electronic) tenders, evaluate offers, and conduct price and contract negotiations, including supplementary and claim management
* Define and implement procurement strategies for your material fields while conducting market and supplier analyses to ensure a cost-efficient and timely supply in the required quality
* Implement defined purchasing methods, processes, and systems in a digital procurement environment
* Oversee supplier management, including qualification, selection, evaluation, and development
* Plan, generate, and document savings to enhance procurement efficiency

What You Bring

* Degree in architecture, civil engineering or industrial engineering with a focus on construction, or a commercial education with a technical construction background
* Many years of experience in project management or procurement of goods and services in the construction industry or real estate-related areas
* Strong negotiation skills and a goal-oriented, proactive approach
* Knowledge in project management specific to procurement as well as contract law and MS Office 
* Proficiency in German and English 

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

About usMenlo Systems is a high-tech company that develops, manufactures and sells lasers and laser systems for precision applications in research and industry. Menlo Systems is one of the market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology. The company is headquartered in Martinsried, near Munich, Germany.

ABOUT THE ROLEERC System develops uncrewed aircraft for certified operation, in a regulatory landscape that is still being written. This role is our presence in the standardisation bodies and industry associations where that landscape takes shape — EUROCAE, GAMA, UAVDACH and BDLI among them — in the working groups drafting the certification specifications, AMC, MOC and supporting standards our aircraft will be measured against. You bring our position into those rooms while the text is still open, and you bring back what it means for us. Inside the company you turn the evolving framework into the certification basis our programmes build against, take part in the exchange with the certification authorities, and support the airworthiness team on compliance work.
WHAT YOU WILL DO● Represent ERC in the associations and standardisation bodies shaping UAS certification standards ● Work inside the drafting groups: comment on drafts, defend positions and follow them through the process ● Track rulemaking and standardisation, and assess early what they mean for our approval route ● Build ERC positions on draft material with engineering, and turn them into written contributions ● Derive and maintain the certification basis for our programmes ● Take part in the exchange with the certification authorities and prepare the input that goes with it ● Support airworthiness on means of compliance and evidence, and flag external changes early

WHAT YOU BRING● Deep, hands-on experience in aviation certification, gained in aircraft or UAS programmes ● Command of the European UAS regulatory system and the derivation of a certification basis ● Experience working in industry associations, standardisation bodies or rulemaking groups ● Comfort in committee settings, where influence comes from preparation rather than authority ● Enough engineering depth to support means of compliance, not only the regulatory argument ● A technical degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable field ● Fluent English, and German at working proficiency for committee and authority work Moreover, it would be helpful if you also ● have worked in an SC Light-UAS or Design Verification Report context ● bring EASA Compliance Verification Engineer experience ● know the military side too, such as STANAG 4671 ● bring an existing network in the European UAS standardisation and association landscape ● bring experience with ARP4754B and ARP4761A

WHAT WEC OFFER● Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides ● A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn ● Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution ● Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation ● Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen ● Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.occupation: Working student - AI & Semantic Data Integration for Digital Transformation Architecture (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the digital architecture team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student - AI & Semantic Data Integration for Digital Transformation Architecture (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know work of a digital architect focusing on the frontier of AI? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the digital architecture team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ottobrunn in the Munich area
- Start: November 2026
- Duration: 12 -24 months

The mission of the architecture unit is to plan and design state of the art, sustainable and secured enterprise digital solutions for our customers, partners and everybody and you can be part of this exciting journey. The transformation programs architecture team, which you will become part of, has the particular mission to define the future to-be target architecture for a full digital continuity of all key value streams of the company. This includes the design of the major enterprise platforms like ALM, PLM, ERP, CRM, MOM/MES but also technology watch and application of emerging technologies. You will specifically focus on the intersection of AI and Data: exploring Agentic Coding, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and building a unified Semantic Layer (using Neo4j) to enable seamless data integration between architect management tools like Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Travelling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Contribute to the research and exploration of Agentic AI workflows and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enterprise use cases.
- Contribute to the development of a Semantic Layer using Graph Databases (Neo4j) to integrate data across Aris, Alfabet, and the Data Catalog.
- Contribute to the design of automated data pipelines and semantic mappings between disparate enterprise architecture tools.
- Contribute to the deployment and orchestration of AI-driven services and integration layers within OpenShift environments.
- Contribute to the modeling of the digital architecture on different layers (business, functional, data, technical) to support the semantic integration.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of computer science, data science, engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in Python programming or working with Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j) is highly desirable.
- Interest in cutting-edge AI developments, specifically LLM Agents, RAG, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud-native environments like OpenShift is a plus.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and data integration patterns is desirable.
- Fluent in German and English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
We are looking for a Global Process Owner Governance Reporting Obligations to drive the governance of tax and tax-related reporting obligations across the operating division. As the global process owner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end governance framework, ensuring effective compliance, robust processes and controls, high-quality data, and transparent documentation standards across all regions. The position reports directly to the Vice President Tax of the operating division.

- You define and continuously develop global reporting standards, governance principles, roles, responsibilities, and compliance requirements for reporting obligations.
- You ensure compliance-by-design by embedding tax, legal, financial reporting, data quality and internal control requirements into reporting processes and systems.
- You oversee reporting-related requirements and solution designs to ensure governance compliance.
- As the central governance authority, you lead decisions and escalations related to reporting obligations, including ownership, control, data quality and design-related topics.
- You ensure transparent governance of reporting obligations through defined ownership, documentation, and control standards.
- Working across functions, you drive continuous improvement and the sustainable implementation of reporting governance requirements.
- degree in computer science, natural sciences or similar education with related work experience
- several years of experience in project and/or change management, preferably in an international environment
- strong knowledge of taxation, Finance Reporting Compliance (FRC) and international tax law
- proven ability to design, transition, and document processes, combined with a structured, solutions-oriented approach and resilience in dynamic environments
- excellent communication skills in English (German optional) combined with the ability to thrive in diverse, global teams and collaborate effectively with stakeholders

The life sciences increasingly depend on advanced services offered by core facilities, synchrotrons, data services and other research infrastructures, creating a need for highly-skilled professionals who can operate, improve and expand these scientific services.

EMBL’s ARISE2 programme offers over 20 fully funded, three-year postdoctoral fellowships for researchers with STEM backgrounds who are interested in advancing their careers in research infrastructures in academia or industry. ARISE2 fellows will:

Develop a method or development within EMBL’s areas of expertise, with potential for broader service application
Receive structured training in the operation and management of research infrastructures, including service provision, project and staff management, innovation, science policy, FAIR principals and AI.
Build professional networks through secondment and job shadowing at EMBL and ARISE2 partner organisations

ARISE2 projects should align with EMBL’s research areas-such as genomics, structural biology, imaging, cell and tissue biology, environmental research, and translational applications-while contributing to the development of services that support the wider life science community.

You may develop projects in fields including:

Data and computational science: Bioinformatics, AI/ML, computational modelling, software engineering, data management, data science.

Imaging and optical engineering: Imaging and image analysis, optical engineering, detector development, microscopy, X-ray optics

Structural Biology and Mechanical Engineering: Automation, high-precision mechanics, microfluidics, robotics, X-ray crystallography

Biotechnology: (Bio)chemical engineering, chemistry or chemical biology, omics technologies.

A Ph.D. at the time of the call deadline (September 30, 2026). Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis but who have not yet been formally awarded the degree are eligible to apply.

The ability to work independently and in a collaborative settings
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
Good organisational and time-management skills

Responsibilities

- You will create DFT specifications, create verification plans, and define the SoC test interface.
- You will develop and implement the DFT architecture and own its integration into large SoC blocks — including IP integration, system and control bus connectivity, and the integration of memories and hard macros.
- You will implement testbenches, generate directed and constrained-random tests, debug failures, run gate-level simulations, and close coverage.
- You will also generate structural test vectors, run synthesis and timing closure and work closely with Chip Architecture, DV, Physical Design, and Power teams to achieve first-tapeout success.
- Additional responsibilities include supporting STA, physical, power, and logical analysis for DFT modes, partnering with Test Engineers to bring up test vectors on silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- B.Sc./M.Sc./PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Solid knowledge of industry-standard DFT practices, including ATPG, JTAG, MBIST, and the trade-offs between test quality and test time.
- Proficient in Verilog and/or VHDL, with hands-on experience using simulators and waveform debugging tools.
- Experience developing DFT specifications and driving DFT architecture and methods for designs.
- Proven understanding of design verification (DV) methodologies for validating DFT implementation in simulation pre-silicon.
- Proficient in a scripting language such as Python, TCL, or Perl, including familiarity or proficiency in leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate scripting and engineering workflows.
- Ability to fluently speak and write in English, including expressing complex technical concepts clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing DFT specifications and driving DFT architecture and methods for designs
- Proven Understanding of design verification (DV) methodologies for validating DFT implementation in simulation pre-silicon
- Experience debugging compressed ATPG patterns, MBIST, and JTAG/1500 related issues.
- Experience with STA constraints development and analysis for DFT modes, as well as SDF simulations.
- Ability to conduct experiments during silicon debug, gathering and analyzing data, and using scripting to support efficient handling of ATE data.
- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
- Experience in large SoC design or verification.
